verdict.rationale: Apify Proxy docs mention rotating datacenter/residential IPs and proxy management via SessionPool/third-party proxies, implying geolocation targeting is common in Apify Proxy, but no direct evidence in this pack shows a documented country-selection parameter (e.g., countryCode) or example of requesting a specific country's proxy. missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-country proxy selection parameter/API, hands-on confirmation that requested country actually routes traffic through that country.
